info.title: Ordnung
info.description: Local API of Ordnung, the private AI secretary for life admin.

get.description:
Version, data folder, demo mode, the app's today, backend, Claude status (cached 10 min), the
model ``ORDNUNG_CLAUDE_MODEL`` pins (if set) and the rules catalog's "law as of" date; with
``probe`` also the doctor's checks.

parameters.name: probe

schema.description: “Run check”: all doctor checks plus one tiny live call (once a minute)
schema.title: Probe

parameters.description: “Run check”: all doctor checks plus one tiny live call (once a minute)

429.description: “Run check” ran less than a minute ago (see ``Retry-After``).

get.description:
The legal rules the date engine uses ("How dates are computed"), with citations. The day they
were last checked against the law is ``rules_last_checked`` of ``GET /api/health``.
Reading jobs, newest first (``active_only``: queued, running and waiting ones).

The person's profile (name, address, region, language, reminders …); on a phone the IBAN shows
only its last 4 characters.

put.description: Change profile fields; a new region (country, postal buffer) recomputes the to-dos' dates.

post.description: Finish the first-run wizard: save the answers and mark the profile onboarded.

get.description:
App settings: the model every call runs on (and the aliases per purpose), concurrency, inbox
folder, AI note.

put.description:
Change settings (``demo`` and ``simulated_today`` can't be changed here); a new inbox folder
restarts the folder watcher, a new model counts from the next call to Claude.

delete.description:
Delete every letter, date, contract, draft, chat and setting — Ordnung starts over empty
(Ordnung's events leave a connected calendar first), and the browser empties its cache.

``body`` must be ``{"confirm": "DELETE"}`` (422 otherwise).

409.description: The demo can't be deleted (``ordnung demo --reset`` starts it over), the connected calendar's events couldn't be removed (nothing was deleted), or no other computer of hand-off sync has this computer's latest changes yet (``not_received``: send ``unreceived_ok``).

get.description: What Ordnung did, newest first (``device``: what one paired phone did).

parameters.name: device

schema.description: Only what this paired phone did (its id)
schema.title: Device

parameters.description: Only what this paired phone did (its id)

get.description: Model calls: tokens, API-equivalent cost, cache hits, per purpose, and the latest calls.

Letters, newest first (trash excluded); ``q`` searches their text. A letter's proof files
(``source="proof"``) are listed with their letter, never here.

schema.title: Response List Documents Api Documents Get

post.description: Store the uploaded letters and queue them for reading.

get.description: One letter with everything the viewer shows.

patch.description: Correct a letter's facts; a confirmed arrival date or corrected letter date recomputes its to-dos.

delete.description: Move a letter to the trash, or with ``purge`` delete it with its pages, to-dos and cache.

post.description: Read the letter again, bypassing the model cache (to-dos the person edited are kept).

get.description: The original file: PDFs and common images inline, anything else as a download.
A rendered page (JPEG, 1-based page number).
A small image of the first page.
The watched folder: its path, whether it is watched, the letters waiting and the last files.

post.description: “Read these”: the waiting letters may be sent to Claude; they are queued for reading.
“Keep private”: the waiting letters stay on this computer and are never sent to Claude.
Undo “Keep private”: letters kept private from waiting (never read by Claude) wait again.

get.description: How the letter was read: every step of one reading, with its model calls, and the kept readings.
What a later reading of the letter decided differently from an earlier one.

404.description: No such letter or reading, or only one reading is kept.

get.description: Every kept reading of the letters not in the trash, as stored (no letter text).

To-dos & dates, soonest first. With a ``from``/``to`` range undated ones are left out unless
``include_undated``. Each says whether it is set aside (``aside``: not one to act on, as on Today).

schema.title: Response List Items Api Items Get

post.description: Add a to-do or date by hand.

get.description: One to-do as a calendar file (with its reminders).
One to-do (with its evidence and "Why this date?" receipt).

patch.description: Edit a to-do: done / snoozed / dismissed, a date of your own, title and notes.

delete.description: Delete a to-do (an explicit click; nothing else ever deletes an obligation).

post.description: "Yes, that's right": the person checked this to-do against the letter.
"These match the letter": the person compared a payment's details with the paper letter.

schema.title: Response Confirm Girocode Api Items  Item Id  Girocode Confirm Post

409.description: Nothing to compare: the details changed since they were shown, the payment has a code already, or it has no code for another reason (the reason is the detail).

get.description: Contracts by name, each with its cancellation dates computed for today.

schema.title: Response List Contracts Api Contracts Get

patch.description: Correct a contract (terms, cost, status); returns it with freshly computed dates.

get.description: Every person and organisation, by name.

schema.title: Response List Parties Api Parties Get

get.description:
One party with its letters (newest first), to-dos (not dismissed), contracts and threads.

``set_aside`` names the open to-dos that are not something to do — an invoice payment a payment
reminder took over, a date that was already history when the letter was read, a letter with
scam signs — so the drawer can list them apart instead of as overdue.

patch.description: Set the Land a sender is in (``null``: "Don't know"); a new one recomputes the dates of its letters.

get.description: A thread: its party, letters (oldest first, like a conversation), to-dos and drafts.
Today: what needs attention, what is coming up, decisions, money, life areas and Ideas.
Everything dated between ``from`` and ``to`` (default: all), in date order.
Life lanes between ``from`` and ``to`` (default: a month back to a year ahead).

About you (Steuer-ID, SV-Nummer …, with their check digits), identity documents with their expiry,
one call sheet per organisation and the open cases with their references (on a phone, your own
numbers show only their last 4 characters: ``masked``).

New letters, values to check, payments this week, letters to post, replies awaited, decisions in
the next 30 days and what to file — and the next day to act ("All clear until …").

post.description: Remember that the weekly session was done now; answers the session as it stands afterwards.
Say "Not now": Today stops suggesting the session until it is due again (a week, or a Sunday).

get.description: Ideas by priority (expired ones only when asked for with ``status=expired``).

schema.title: Response List Suggestions Api Suggestions Get

patch.description: Accept, dismiss ("Not relevant"), snooze ("Remind me in a week"), mark done — or undo.

post.description: Ask Claude to look over the ledger for new Ideas (in the background).

get.description: Today's note: the stored one Claude wrote, else the agenda written by code as it stands now.

post.description:
Write today's note again (Claude when "AI note" is on and available, else code; ``llm=false``: code
only, from the records — ``ordnung brief --no-llm``).
Answer a question about the person's records, streamed.

get.description: The questions and answers of a thread, oldest first.

schema.title: Response Chat Thread Api Chat  Thread Id  Get

get.description: Every letter, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Drafts Api Drafts Get

post.description:
Draft a cancellation, objection, reply or template letter (withdrawal, more time, instalments,
defect, data access, receipts, deposit, new address): fixed legal wording, model-written courtesy
text and translation, automatic checks and "how to send it".

get.description: One letter.

patch.description:
Edit the letter; the checks (placeholders, references, dates …) run again. A sent letter is
refused: it stays as it went out.

409.description: A sent letter's text can't be changed.

delete.description:
Delete a letter with its proofs; their files are deleted for good too unless ``keep_proof_files``
(they then stay as documents of their own).

post.description: Translate the letter again, as it stands after your edits (only the translation changes).

409.description: The zero-token demo can't ask the model for a new translation.

get.description: The letter as a printable DIN 5008 PDF (a sent letter as it went out).
The printable letter as one PNG, page under page (the web app's print preview).

post.description: Record that the letter was sent (channel and day) and add a follow-up to-do.

get.description:
A letter's proof: tracking number, proofs with what each shows, timeline, what's missing and
what the letter waits for.

put.description: Save the tracking number of a sent letter (checked: a mistyped check digit is refused).

post.description:
Attach a proof file to a sent letter. The file is kept private: it is never sent to Claude. A file
already in Ordnung is linked as it is, and ``notice`` says what that means for it.

patch.description: Correct what a proof is, the day it shows or its note.

delete.description: Remove a proof; its file is deleted for good unless another proof uses it.

post.description: Say the sent letter was answered (by a letter in Ordnung, or otherwise); closes its follow-up.

delete.description: Take back "it's answered": the letter waits again and its follow-up reopens.

get.description: The Nachweis: a summary with the timeline, the letter as sent and every proof file, as one PDF.

Replies, money and callbacks you are waiting for: overdue first, then the ones a letter may have
answered, then the rest — each by expected day.

schema.title: Response List Waiting Api Waiting Get

get.description: Call notes, newest call first (of one person or organisation, or one thread).

schema.title: Response List Calls Api Calls Get

post.description: Note a phone call. Nothing is sent anywhere; no AI reads it.

patch.description: Say the promise made on the call was kept (or take that back).

get.description: All open dates as an iCalendar file.

post.description: Remember that the dates were just added to the person's calendar.

get.description: Whether calendar sync can be used here, the connected calendar and the last sync.

put.description: Connect a calendar (checked with its server first) and send the events; or change the mode.

409.description: Not connected, connected elsewhere, the demo, or no password store on this computer

422.description: The address, user name or app password can't be used (``code`` says which)

502.description: The calendar server couldn't be reached or answered with an error

get.description: Every event exactly as calendar sync would send it in ``mode`` (nothing is sent).

post.description:
The calendars that take events at or under ``url`` (the account's calendar home, found the
way calendar apps find it). Nothing is stored or written.

409.description: Not connected, connected elsewhere, the demo, or no password store on this computer

422.description: The address, user name or app password can't be used (``code`` says which)

502.description: The calendar server couldn't be reached or answered with an error

post.description: Send what changed now (the report is in ``last_sync``; a paused sync resumes).

409.description: Not connected, connected elsewhere, the demo, or no password store on this computer

422.description: The address, user name or app password can't be used (``code`` says which)

502.description: The calendar server couldn't be reached or answered with an error

post.description: Forget the calendar and its app password — first removing Ordnung's events if asked (only those).

409.description: Not connected, connected elsewhere, the demo, or no password store on this computer

422.description: The address, user name or app password can't be used (``code`` says which)

502.description: The calendar server couldn't be reached or answered with an error

get.description:
The desktop notification's tool, today's text in each mode (unless ``preview`` is false: both
``null``), and the start-at-login entry.

parameters.name: preview

schema.description: Include today's texts (built from the agenda)
schema.title: Preview

parameters.description: Include today's texts (built from the agenda)

post.description: Show today's notification now (a sample when nothing is due); the morning one still comes.

get.description: What an encrypted backup would hold now, and how long its passphrase must be.

post.description: An encrypted backup of everything (database, letters, page images, letter PDFs) as a download.

422.description: The passphrase is too short or too long (the rule, never the value)

get.description:
Whether phone access can be used here and is on, its address, certificate, pairing progress and
the paired phones.

put.description:
Turn phone access on (at the chosen or recommended address) or off; a new address or port means
pairing phones again.

409.description: The demo or no session token (``unavailable``), Ordnung isn't set up yet (``not_set_up``), no home network (``no_network``) or the port is in use (``port_busy``)

422.description: The address isn't one of this computer's, or the port is out of range (``invalid``)

post.description: A new pairing code (replacing an open one): one phone, once, within minutes.

409.description: The demo or no session token (``unavailable``), phone access isn't listening (``not_listening``) or the most phones are paired (``too_many_phones``)

delete.description: Cancel the open pairing code (the dialog closed).
Remove a paired phone: it is signed out at once and its live connections end.

post.description:
Start over: turn phone access off, remove every phone and its certificate (a new one is made
when it is turned on again).

409.description: The demo (``unavailable``)

post.description: Pair this phone with the code shown on the computer; the answer sets its sign-in cookie.

404.description: Sent to the computer's own listener, not a phone's (``not_phone``)

409.description: The code paired a phone already, so neither stays paired (``code_used``), the most phones are paired (``too_many_phones``) or phone access is off (``unavailable``)

422.description: The code didn't match, or it expired, or there is none (``wrong_code``)

429.description: Too many tries from this device or the network (``too_many``, see ``Retry-After``)

get.description:
Whether sync can be used here, this computer's mode, the other computers, a choice, problems,
notices and kept copies (from memory: never the folder or the password store).

put.description:
Set up a new sync folder (the passphrase twice in the form) or join an existing one; joining
while this computer has letters answers the choice first, unless ``keep`` answers it.

409.description: the demo, or no usable password store on this computer (``unavailable``); this computer already syncs (``already_connected``); the folder was set up by a newer Ordnung (``newer_ordnung``); the folder already serves 8 computers (``full``); the folder's key file hasn't fully arrived yet (``not_arrived``); this computer isn't syncing (``not_connected``)

422.description: the folder can't be used (``folder``); the name is empty or too long (``name``); a new folder's passphrase is too short or too easy to guess (``passphrase``); the passphrase doesn't open this folder (``wrong_passphrase``)

507.description: this computer lacks the space to bring Ordnung over (``no_space``)

delete.description:
Disconnect this computer: its last changes are saved first, its head says it left, and
``<data>/sync/`` goes (kept copies stay). The folder and the other computers keep everything.

409.description: the demo, or no usable password store on this computer (``unavailable``); no other computer has this computer's latest changes yet: ``unreceived_ok`` goes on (``not_received``)

patch.description: Rename this computer, answer a problem, or dismiss a notice.

409.description: the demo, or no usable password store on this computer (``unavailable``); this computer isn't syncing (``not_connected``); there's nothing to confirm or give up now (``not_needed``)

422.description: the name is empty or too long (``name``)

post.description: What ``folder`` would be: a new sync, one to join, or refused (and why). Nothing is written.

409.description: the demo, or no usable password store on this computer (``unavailable``); this computer isn't syncing (``not_connected``)

post.description:
“Use Ordnung here”: bring everything over and make this computer the one in use — or wait until
it has arrived (``take_over_waiting``), or answer with the choice when both computers changed.

409.description: the demo, or no usable password store on this computer (``unavailable``); this computer isn't syncing (``not_connected``); the other computer runs a newer Ordnung: update Ordnung here (``newer_ordnung``); a take-over must finish first (``pull_unfinished``); the passphrase isn't in the password store (``passphrase_needed``); the folder has a problem that stops a take-over (``folder_problem``)

507.description: this computer lacks the space to take over (``no_space``)

post.description:
Keep the chosen computer's Ordnung; the other one is kept as an encrypted copy on its own
computer. Choosing makes this computer the one in use.

409.description: the demo, or no usable password store on this computer (``unavailable``); this computer isn't syncing (``not_connected``); there's nothing to choose, or no such side (``no_choice``); the chosen side hasn't arrived and can't be waited for (``not_arrived``); the passphrase is needed to keep this computer's copy (``passphrase_needed``); the folder has a problem that stops this (``folder_problem``)

507.description: this computer lacks the space for it (``no_space``)

post.description: Save into the sync folder now; ``hand_over`` then stands by.

409.description: the demo, or no usable password store on this computer (``unavailable``); this computer isn't syncing (``not_connected``); another computer is in use (``standby``); the folder can't be written now (``folder_problem``)

post.description: Type the passphrase again: checked against the folder, then kept in the password store.

409.description: the demo, or no usable password store on this computer (``unavailable``); this computer isn't syncing (``not_connected``)

422.description: the passphrase doesn't open this folder (``wrong_passphrase``)

post.description:
Fill an emptied sync folder again from this computer (never done by itself: an unmounted share
looks empty too).

409.description: the demo, or no usable password store on this computer (``unavailable``); this computer isn't syncing (``not_connected``); the folder isn't empty, or another computer is in use (``not_needed``)

delete.description:
Forget a lost computer: its changes that are nowhere else are kept as a copy here first. It
still knows the passphrase (a new sync folder locks it out).

404.description: no other computer has that number (``not_found``)

409.description: the demo, or no usable password store on this computer (``unavailable``); this computer isn't syncing (``not_connected``); that computer is the one in use (take over first) (``in_use``); its latest changes haven't arrived here, so they can't be kept yet (``not_arrived``); the passphrase is needed to keep its changes (``passphrase_needed``)

507.description: this computer lacks the space to keep its changes (``no_space``)

get.description:
A kept copy as a download (open it with ``ordnung restore`` and the sync passphrase). ``name``
must match :data:`~ordnung.sync.KEPT_RE` and be listed in the status.

404.description: no kept copy of that name (``not_found``)

delete.description: Delete a kept copy for good.

404.description: no kept copy of that name (``not_found``)

409.description: the demo, or no usable password store on this computer (``unavailable``)

get.description: Subscribe to live updates (job progress, new Ideas, day change, rate-limit pauses).
Where the person is in the guided tour.

patch.description: Move through, skip or finish the tour.

get.description:
The Ask page's suggested questions — word for word the ones the demo has recorded answers for; none
once the letters or to-dos changed since the demo started (the recorded answers no longer fit).

schema.title: Response Suggested Questions Api Demo Questions Get

get.description: The letters waiting in the "New mail" tray.

schema.title: Response Mail Tray Api Demo Mail Get

post.description: Open a tray letter: it is read live (replayed answers) with the usual progress events.

interface.title: Interface
interface.description: The network interface it belongs to (“en0”, “Wi-Fi”)

subnet.title: Subnet
subnet.description: Its network (“192.168.178.0/24”): only devices in it are answered

recommended.title: Recommended
recommended.description: The address this computer reaches the internet from (never a VPN)

AddressChoice.title: AddressChoice
AddressChoice.description: An address of this computer on a home network that phone access could use.

AdviceFact.title: AdviceFact
AdviceFact.description: One computed or legal point on a high-stakes letter's card (e.g. the rent cap check).

AnsweredRequest.title: AnsweredRequest
AnsweredRequest.description: The sent letter was answered — by this letter (``doc_id``), or by phone, e-mail … (``null``).

AskRequest.title: AskRequest
AskRequest.description: A question, optionally continuing an earlier thread.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: systemd user service, LaunchAgent or Startup folder

points_here.title: Points Here
points_here.description: The entry starts this data folder

command.title: Command
command.description: The command that starts this data folder at login (null: the demo, which doesn't)

AutostartInfo.title: AutostartInfo
AutostartInfo.description: Whether ``ordnung autostart`` starts Ordnung at login, and for which data folder.

letters.title: Letters
letters.description: Letters, the trash included (as the backup holds them)

files.title: Files
files.description: Originals, page images and letter PDFs

bytes.title: Bytes
bytes.description: Their size plus the database's, before encryption

left_out.title: Left Out
left_out.description: Symbolic links under the backed-up folders (or a folder that is one), which a backup leaves out: it never follows links

BackupInfo.title: BackupInfo
BackupInfo.description: What a backup made now would hold.

BackupRequest.title: BackupRequest
BackupRequest.description: The passphrase that protects the backup (checked against the policy by the route).

file.title: File
file.description: The proof: a photo or PDF of a receipt, a fax report, an e-mail …

combine.title: Combine
combine.description: Photos of this upload are pages of one letter

private.title: Private
private.description: Keep private — never sent to Claude

Box.title: Box
Box.description: Highlight rectangle in relative coordinates (0..1) on a rendered page image.

CalendarEventPreview.title: CalendarEventPreview
CalendarEventPreview.description: One event exactly as calendar sync would send it.

CalendarExportResult.title: CalendarExportResult
CalendarExportResult.description: When the person last exported their dates.

CalendarSyncConnect.title: CalendarSyncConnect
CalendarSyncConnect.description: The calendar to connect; ``password: null`` keeps the saved app password (to change the mode).

CalendarSyncDisconnect.title: CalendarSyncDisconnect
CalendarSyncDisconnect.description: Whether to remove Ordnung's events from the calendar before forgetting it.

CalendarSyncDisconnected.title: CalendarSyncDisconnected
CalendarSyncDisconnected.description: How many of Ordnung's events were removed from the calendar.

CalendarSyncFind.title: CalendarSyncFind
CalendarSyncFind.description: Where to look for calendars, and the account to look with (nothing is stored).

CalendarSyncFound.title: CalendarSyncFound
CalendarSyncFound.description: The calendars Ordnung could write into (the address itself first, when it is one).

CalendarSyncPreview.title: CalendarSyncPreview
CalendarSyncPreview.description: Exactly what each event would contain in ``mode``.

available.title: Available
available.description: Calendar sync can be used on this computer

install_command.title: Install Command
install_command.description: The command that makes it available

calendar_name.title: Calendar Name
calendar_name.description: The calendar's name on the server

password_saved.title: Password Saved
password_saved.description: The app password was in this computer's keyring when Ordnung last needed it

paused.title: Paused
paused.description: Automatic syncing waits after a refused password

synced.title: Synced
synced.description: How many of Ordnung's events are in the calendar

CalendarSyncStatus.title: CalendarSyncStatus
CalendarSyncStatus.description: What Settings shows about calendar sync.

CallNote.title: CallNote
CallNote.description:
A phone call the person noted (Gesprächsnotiz): when, with whom, what was said and what was
promised. A promise with a date is waited for (``secretary.waiting``).

CallNoteCreate.title: CallNoteCreate
CallNoteCreate.description:
A phone call to note: when, with whom, what was said and what they promised (a promise with a
day is waited for).

CallNotePatch.title: CallNotePatch
CallNotePatch.description: Whether the call's promise was kept.

CallSheet.title: CallSheet
CallSheet.description: Everything to have at hand when you call or write to one organisation.

CancellationSent.title: CancellationSent
CancellationSent.description:
The person's cancellation of a contract, marked as sent (a ``cancellation`` letter with the
contract's id): the decision is taken, what is left is waiting for the provider's confirmation.

send_by.title: Send By
send_by.description: None for a fee paid at an appointment

at_appointment.title: At Appointment
at_appointment.description: A fee paid in person at the appointment: on its day, never a transfer

needs_check.title: Needs Check
needs_check.description: Its date or amount is not confirmed against the letter (compare it)

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: A payment's direction: money coming in is expected on its day, never overdue

CaseItemRef.title: CaseItemRef
CaseItemRef.description: The next open to-do of a case.

CitationRef.title: CitationRef
CitationRef.description: A validated citation as sent to the UI with the final answer.

ContractPatch.title: ContractPatch
ContractPatch.description: Corrections to a contract's terms; its dates are recomputed by the rules engine.

removed.title: Removed
removed.description: Entries of the data folder that were deleted

kept.title: Kept
kept.description: Entries Ordnung did not create, left untouched

calendar_events_removed.title: Calendar Events Removed
calendar_events_removed.description: Ordnung's events removed from the connected calendar first (null: none was connected, or another computer still sends to it)

calendar_shared_with.title: Calendar Shared With
calendar_shared_with.description: Hand-off sync: another computer that sends to the same calendar, so Ordnung's events were left there and only this computer's connection was removed

DateSpec.title: DateSpec
DateSpec.description: What a document *says* about a date. The rules engine turns this into a concrete date.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: Exactly "DELETE" — what the person typed to confirm

unreceived_ok.title: Unreceived Ok
unreceived_ok.description: Hand-off sync: delete although no other computer has this computer's latest changes yet (the second confirmation; otherwise 409 ``not_received``)

DesktopPreview.title: DesktopPreview
DesktopPreview.description: Today's notification in each mode (``null``: nothing is due, so none would be shown).

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: notify-send, osascript or powershell (null: none found)

missing.title: Missing
missing.description: Why no notification can be shown, if so

last_shown_on.title: Last Shown On
last_shown_on.description: The last day the morning notification was shown (or done with)

last_failure.title: Last Failure
last_failure.description: Why the system couldn't show the last notification (null: it could)

demo.title: Demo
demo.description: The demo: it never notifies on its own

DesktopReminders.title: DesktopReminders
DesktopReminders.description: What Settings shows about the morning desktop notification.

DesktopTestRequest.title: DesktopTestRequest
DesktopTestRequest.description: Which mode to show the test notification in.

DesktopTestResult.title: DesktopTestResult
DesktopTestResult.description: Whether the test notification was shown, and what it said.

DoctorCheck.title: DoctorCheck
DoctorCheck.description:
One ``ordnung doctor`` check: what was looked at, the outcome and — when it is not ok — how to
fix it.

DocumentPatch.title: DocumentPatch
DocumentPatch.description:
Corrections the person can make to a letter. ``received_date`` (when the letter arrived) and
``doc_date`` recompute the letter's to-dos with the rules engine unless ``received_confirmed`` is
``false``; so does ``kind``, which decides the rules of high-stakes letters (a court order, a
dismissal …).

DocumentTrace.title: DocumentTrace
DocumentTrace.description:
How a letter was read: the reading shown (the latest unless another was asked for), its steps
and every reading Ordnung keeps (newest first).

case_id.title: Case Id
case_id.description: accepted for symmetry; the thread follows the letter

details.description: the facts a template letter needs (withdrawal, payment plan …)

suspend_enforcement.title: Suspend Enforcement
suspend_enforcement.description: an objection also applies to suspend enforcement (einstweilige Einstellung at a court, Aussetzung der Vollziehung at an authority); ignored for other letters and a court payment order

DraftCreate.title: DraftCreate
DraftCreate.description: What to write: the kind of letter and what it is about.

DraftPatch.title: DraftPatch
DraftPatch.description: Edits the person makes to a draft (the checks run again).

EmailAttachment.title: EmailAttachment
EmailAttachment.description:
One attachment of an e-mail and what Ordnung did with it (:mod:`ordnung.ingest.attachments`).

``added``: it became a letter of its own (``doc_id``); ``known``: the same file was already in
Ordnung (``doc_id``); ``inline``: a picture shown inside the e-mail (a logo), skipped; ``not_read``: a
type Ordnung does not read from e-mails (a zip, a Word file …), listed only; ``refused``: intake
refused it (``detail`` says why); ``over_limit``: past the most attachments read from one e-mail.
``doc_id`` is only set while that letter exists and is not in the trash.

Evidence.title: Evidence

FolderPickup.title: FolderPickup
FolderPickup.description:
A file the watched folder brought in (from the activity log, newest first).

``added``: it became a letter (``doc_id``, its ``status`` now); ``known``: the same file was already
in Ordnung; ``refused``: intake refused it (``detail`` says why). ``doc_id`` and ``status`` are
``None`` once that letter is gone.

FolderStatus.title: FolderStatus
FolderStatus.description: ``GET /api/folder``: the watched folder, whether it is watched, and what it brought in.

GiroCodeBlocked.title: GiroCodeBlocked
GiroCodeBlocked.description:
Why a payment has no GiroCode, in plain words (``message``). For ``check_letter``, ``to_check``
names the details to compare with the paper letter and ``values`` are the ones to confirm.

GiroCodeConfirm.title: GiroCodeConfirm
GiroCodeConfirm.description: The transfer details the person compared with the paper letter, exactly as they were shown.

GiroCodeReady.title: GiroCodeReady
GiroCodeReady.description:
A GiroCode for one payment: ``payload`` is the EPC069-12 text to show as a QR code at error
correction level M. ``checked``: the person compared these details with the paper letter.

model_pinned.title: Model Pinned
model_pinned.description: The model ``ORDNUNG_CLAUDE_MODEL`` pins for every call while it is set (the saved model waits)

rules_last_checked.title: Rules Last Checked
rules_last_checked.description: The day the rules catalog was last checked against the law (“Based on the law as of …”)

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: The doctor's checks — only with ``?probe=1`` (“Run check”)

client.title: Client
client.description: Who asked: this computer's browser, or a paired phone (which gets no data folder, Claude path or checks)

HeldRequest.title: HeldRequest
HeldRequest.description: The waiting letters the person answered for (as shown to them).

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: ids that were not waiting (any more)

HeldResult.title: HeldResult
HeldResult.description: What an answer changed: the letters, the reading jobs queued (Read only), ids no longer waiting.

HelpLink.title: HelpLink
HelpLink.description: Independent, free or low-cost help for a high-stakes letter (information, not legal advice).

note.title: Note
note.description: What to do about it (written by code)

needs_check.title: Needs Check
needs_check.description: The expiry date is not confirmed against the letter (compare it)

IdentityDocument.title: IdentityDocument
IdentityDocument.description: A passport, residence permit or ID card: its number (when a letter shows it) and expiry.

ItemAside.title: ItemAside
ItemAside.description:
An open to-do that is not one to act on (worked out on read, never stored).

``replaced``: a payment reminder (``replaced_by``, a document id) took over the invoice payment —
pay once, not twice. ``attached``: an e-mail's payment that the bill attached to it
(``replaced_by``) asks for too. ``history``: its date had long passed when the letter was read (an
archive letter). ``suspicious``: the letter shows signs of a scam.

ItemCreate.title: ItemCreate
ItemCreate.description: A to-do or date the person adds by hand.

ItemPatch.title: ItemPatch
ItemPatch.description: Edits to a to-do; ``notes`` is accepted as another name for ``description``.

LetterAdvice.title: LetterAdvice
LetterAdvice.description:
The "get advice" card of a high-stakes letter, worked out on read (:mod:`ordnung.rules.advice`).

``urgent`` letters (court orders, a dismissal) always carry it; the others show it as information.

subject_matter.title: Subject Matter
subject_matter.description: what was ordered or agreed, e.g. 'Kaffeemaschine'

ordered_on.title: Ordered On
ordered_on.description: the day the contract was concluded

instructions_missing.title: Instructions Missing
instructions_missing.description: no (or wrong) instructions about the right of withdrawal were given

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: the deadline that should be extended

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: the total owed, or the deposit

first_instalment.title: First Instalment
first_instalment.description: the day of the first instalment

fix_by.title: Fix By
fix_by.description: the day by which it should be repaired

moved_out_on.title: Moved Out On
moved_out_on.description: the day the flat was handed back

recipient.title: Recipient
recipient.description: name and address of a recipient not in Ordnung yet

LetterDetails.title: LetterDetails
LetterDetails.description:
Facts a template letter needs besides the letter, contract or person it is about.

Everything is optional here; each template names the facts it requires
(:data:`ordnung.drafts.templates.TEMPLATES`). Dates are ISO ``YYYY-MM-DD`` (anything else is refused
with a clear message, never a server error), amounts in euros.

LetterRef.title: LetterRef
LetterRef.description: A letter a number or case links to.

ListedItem.title: ListedItem
ListedItem.description:
A to-do as the list (``GET /api/items``) returns it.

``aside`` is worked out on read (never stored): why the to-do is not one to act on — the same
rules as Today, the letter's verdict and the party drawer (:class:`ItemAside`) — so the Inbox
neither counts it nor shows it as a letter's next step; ``None`` for one to act on.

MailOpenResult.title: MailOpenResult
MailOpenResult.description: The letter being read live and its job.

tracking_number.title: Tracking Number
tracking_number.description: the Einschreiben's number (its check digit is checked)

MarkSentRequest.title: MarkSentRequest
MarkSentRequest.description: How and when the letter was sent.

ModelSettings.title: ModelSettings
ModelSettings.description:
A request's own model per purpose. It keys the recordings (an alias, so they survive a change
of :attr:`AppSettings.model`); the model the CLI runs is decided at call time
(:meth:`ordnung.llm.claude_cli.ClaudeCLIBackend.model_for`), and the cache is keyed by that one.

name.title: Name
name.description: What it is, in plain English (“Tax ID (Steuer-ID)”)

label.title: Label
label.description: The label the letter prints next to it

copy_value.title: Copy Value
copy_value.description: What “Copy” puts on the clipboard (forms want no spaces)

letter.description: The latest letter that shows it

MyNumber.title: MyNumber
MyNumber.description:
One number as Ordnung sorted it (:mod:`ordnung.numbers`): the value as printed, how to read and
copy it, the check-digit test and the latest letter that shows it.

masked.title: Masked
masked.description: The numbers show only their last 4 characters (on a phone): the full ones are on your computer

skip_ai.title: Skip Ai
skip_ai.description: “Continue without AI”: no model-written daily note and no weekly Ideas review

OpenCase.title: OpenCase
OpenCase.description: A matter with an open one-off to-do, and the references to quote when you call or write.

code.title: Code
code.description: As shown or typed; spaces, dashes and case don't matter

PairRequest.title: PairRequest
PairRequest.description: The code from the computer and the name this phone gets.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name it got (“iPhone (2)” when the name was taken)

check_words.title: Check Words
check_words.description: Two words the computer shows next to this phone (“amber tulip”)

PairResult.title: PairResult
PairResult.description: The phone is paired: its sign-in cookie comes with this answer.

region.title: Region
region.description: the Land (Bundesland) the sender is in, as a code like NW or BY; null: not known

PartyPatch.title: PartyPatch
PartyPatch.description: What the person tells Ordnung about a sender.

address.title: Address
address.description: One of ``addresses`` (none: the saved or recommended one)

home_network.title: Home Network
home_network.description: “This is my home network”: the network this computer is on now is home (after ``other_network``)

PhoneAccessChange.title: PhoneAccessChange
PhoneAccessChange.description: Turn phone access on or off; choose the address or port; confirm the home network.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name given when it was paired (“Anna's iPhone”)

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: A summary of its browser (“iPhone · Safari”), never the User-Agent

check_words.title: Check Words
check_words.description: Two words the phone showed when it was paired (“amber tulip”): a phone that shows other words isn't this one

last_address.title: Last Address
last_address.description: The address it was last used from

active.title: Active
active.description: It has Ordnung open now (a live connection)

recent_changes.title: Recent Changes
recent_changes.description: Changes it made in the last 30 days (the privacy log, filtered by ``device``)

code.title: Code
code.description: ``pairing_stopped``: so many wrong codes were typed that the code was cancelled; ``code_reused``: two devices used the same code, so neither is paired; ``token_reuse``: a phone's sign-in was used from two places, so it was signed out

PhoneNotice.title: PhoneNotice
PhoneNotice.description: Something the person should know about at once (shown in the danger tone).

PhonePairing.title: PhonePairing
PhonePairing.description: A new pairing code: shown on the computer, valid once for a few minutes.

opened_at.title: Opened At
opened_at.description: When a phone that isn't paired yet opened the pairing page

opened_from.title: Opened From
opened_from.description: The address that phone opened it from

wrong_tries.title: Wrong Tries
wrong_tries.description: Wrong codes typed on the network since this code was made

wrong_from.title: Wrong From
wrong_from.description: The addresses the wrong codes came from

PhonePairingState.title: PhonePairingState
PhonePairingState.description: The pairing code's progress (never the code).

code.title: Code
code.description: ``no_network``: no home network; ``address_gone``: this computer isn't on the saved address any more; ``other_network``: the same address on another network (the router differs); ``port_busy``: another program uses the port; ``failed``: anything else

PhoneProblem.title: PhoneProblem
PhoneProblem.description: Why phone access is on but not listening, in words for the person (technical text only in logs).

available.title: Available
available.description: Phone access can be turned on here (never in the demo)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Phone access is turned on (the saved choice)

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.description: This computer's addresses on home networks now

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: The certificate's SHA-256 as upper-case byte pairs (“F2 08 81 E8 …”)

ca_fingerprint.title: Ca Fingerprint
ca_fingerprint.description: The SHA-256 of the authority that issues it (what a phone may trust)

ca_made_at.title: Ca Made At
ca_made_at.description: When that authority was made: a new address makes a new one, and phones that trusted the old one should remove it

certificate_changed_at.title: Certificate Changed At
certificate_changed_at.description: When the certificate last changed (phones that don't trust it warn again)

Proof.title: Proof
Proof.description:
One piece of proof that a letter was sent or arrived. ``doc_id`` is its file: a private outgoing
document (``source="proof"``) that is never sent to a model. ``on_date`` is the day it shows (the
day posted, delivered, faxed or confirmed).

ProofEntry.title: ProofEntry
ProofEntry.description: A proof with its file and, in code-written words, what it shows and what it does not.

ProofEvent.title: ProofEvent
ProofEvent.description:
One line of a sent letter's timeline (the "Nachweis"). ``date`` is ``None`` for a proof without a
day (listed apart, with ``added_on``: the day it was added). ``possible_answer``: a letter that may be
the answer — shown to the person, never written into the Nachweis.

ProofLink.title: ProofLink
ProofLink.description: A sent letter this document is proof of (``drafts.proof``): the letter and what the proof is.

ProofOverview.title: ProofOverview
ProofOverview.description:
``GET /api/drafts/{id}/proof``: a letter's tracking number, proofs, timeline, what is missing and
what it waits for.

ProofPatch.title: ProofPatch
ProofPatch.description: Corrections to a proof: what it is, the day it shows and a note (``null`` or empty removes them).

PublicHealth.title: PublicHealth
PublicHealth.description: What ``GET /api/health`` tells a caller that has not signed in with the session token.

PurposeUsage.title: PurposeUsage
PurposeUsage.description:
Model use for one purpose (``extract``, ``ask`` …). ``input_tokens`` counts every prompt token, those
read from or written to the prompt cache too.

working_day.title: Working Day
working_day.description: the Nth working day of each period, e.g. 3 for 'spätestens am dritten Werktag eines jeden Monats', -1 for the last ('am letzten Bankarbeitstag des Monats'); empty for a day of the month

day_of_month.title: Day Of Month
day_of_month.description: the day of each month it is due on, e.g. 1 for 'zum 1. eines Monats' or 'zum Monatsanfang', 31 for 'zum Monatsende' (a month's last day); empty for a working day

working_day.title: Working Day
working_day.description: the Nth working day of each period, e.g. 3 for 'spätestens am dritten Werktag eines jeden Monats', -1 for the last ('am letzten Bankarbeitstag des Monats'); empty for a day of the month

day_of_month.title: Day Of Month
day_of_month.description: the day of each month it is due on, e.g. 1 for 'zum 1. eines Monats' or 'zum Monatsanfang', 31 for 'zum Monatsende' (a month's last day); empty for a working day

ReviewStarted.title: ReviewStarted
ReviewStarted.description: ``POST /api/suggestions/review``: whether a review was started or one is already running.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: The group it is listed under (“Counting periods”, “Price increases” …)

model.title: Model
model.description: the model every call runs on: an id or alias Claude Code accepts (claude-sonnet-5 by default)

inbox_auto_read.title: Inbox Auto Read
inbox_auto_read.description: read new files from the watched folder at once (else they wait for you)

desktop_notify_time.title: Desktop Notify Time
desktop_notify_time.description: Local time of day, HH:MM (24 h)

SettingsPatch.title: SettingsPatch
SettingsPatch.description: Settings to change (all optional; ``models`` is merged by purpose).

text.title: Text
text.description: tool label/summary or the checked answer (done); none on the text event that says the answer is being written

error_code.title: Error Code
error_code.description: why there is no answer (error), when asking again can't help: demo_miss — the demo has no recorded answer for this question; demo_changed — the demo recorded it, but the letters or to-dos changed since the demo started (it has to start over)

note.title: Note
note.description: what the answer check left out or quoted (done); shown apart from the text

note_label.title: Note Label
note_label.description: the label of the note in the answer's language (done), e.g. 'Checked by Ordnung:'

StreamEvent.title: StreamEvent
StreamEvent.description: One event of the streamed answer (the JSON data of an SSE ``message`` event).

SuggestionPatch.title: SuggestionPatch
SuggestionPatch.description: The person's answer to an Idea (``new`` undoes an earlier answer).

since.title: Since
since.description: This computer's clock: when waiting began

online_only.title: Online Only
online_only.description: Files the sync tool keeps online-only on this computer (placeholders, dataless files): they arrive only once the folder is available offline

SyncArriving.title: SyncArriving
SyncArriving.description: A version still arriving from the sync tool.

name.title: Name
name.description: A new name for this computer

confirm_same_computer.title: Confirm Same Computer
confirm_same_computer.description: “This is the same computer” (after the data folder moved or was copied)

keep_as_is.title: Keep As Is
keep_as_is.description: “Keep this computer's data as it is” (after it went back in time and the last saved state can't be put back)

abandon_pull.title: Abandon Pull
abandon_pull.description: Give up a take-over that couldn't finish (this computer stands by)

SyncChange.title: SyncChange
SyncChange.description: Small changes and answers to a problem (each optional).

joining.title: Joining
joining.description: This computer is joining and already has its own letters

chosen.title: Chosen
chosen.description: The side chosen while it still arrives: kept as soon as it is here (``use-here`` with ``cancel`` stops waiting)

SyncChoice.title: SyncChoice
SyncChoice.description: Both computers changed something: which computer's Ordnung to keep (the other is kept as a copy).

key.title: Key
key.description: A small number for the UI, stable per computer (``choose``, ``forget``)

in_use.title: In Use
in_use.description: It is the one in use

state.title: State
state.description: What its latest head says: ``in_use``, ``standing_by``, ``closed`` (Ordnung was closed there while in use), ``left`` (it disconnected) or ``unknown`` (its head can't be read now)

arrived_at.title: Arrived At
arrived_at.description: This computer's clock: when that computer's latest change arrived here

has_latest.title: Has Latest
has_latest.description: This computer's latest saved version has fully arrived there (null: can't tell, or this computer)

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Calendar sync there, compared with this computer's: ``none``; ``same`` calendar and mode; ``different_mode`` (the same calendar in another mode); ``other`` (another calendar, or none here)

SyncComputer.title: SyncComputer
SyncComputer.description: A computer of this sync, as this computer sees it (never its id).

keep.title: Keep
keep.description: Joining while this computer has its own letters: keep this computer's Ordnung, or the folder's (the other is kept as a copy)

SyncConnect.title: SyncConnect
SyncConnect.description: Set up a new sync folder or join one (the passphrase is checked by the route).

choice.description: Joining while this computer has its own letters: send ``keep`` to answer (nothing is connected yet)

SyncConnected.title: SyncConnected
SyncConnected.description: The result of setting up or joining: the status, or the choice to answer first.

forget_passphrase.title: Forget Passphrase
forget_passphrase.description: Also remove it from the password store

unreceived_ok.title: Unreceived Ok
unreceived_ok.description: Disconnect although no other computer has this computer's latest changes yet (the second confirmation)

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: ``new``: missing or empty (apart from sync-tool files): a new sync starts there; ``existing``: a sync to join; ``refused``: it can't be used (``problem`` says why)

folder.title: Folder
folder.description: The folder as Ordnung would use it (resolved)

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: Why it can't be used, for people

examples.title: Examples
examples.description: Up to three names of other files found in it

data_folder_synced.title: Data Folder Synced
data_folder_synced.description: Ordnung's data folder itself is inside a synced folder (a warning, never a refusal)

links_left_out.title: Links Left Out
links_left_out.description: Symbolic links in the data folder that sync leaves out (it never follows links)

SyncFolderInfo.title: SyncFolderInfo
SyncFolderInfo.description: What a folder would be for sync (nothing is written).

path.title: Path
path.description: Where it is on this computer (for ``ordnung restore``)

why.title: Why
why.description: Why it was kept, for people (“before you kept desktop's Ordnung”)

SyncKept.title: SyncKept
SyncKept.description: A kept copy: this computer's data saved before it was replaced (an encrypted backup).

SyncLetter.title: SyncLetter
SyncLetter.description: A letter in a side's summary: its title and the calendar date it was added (no clock time).

kept.title: Kept
kept.description: The kept copy it is about (its name)

SyncNotice.title: SyncNotice
SyncNotice.description: Something the person should know about once (dismissed with ``PATCH /api/sync``).

SyncPassphrase.title: SyncPassphrase
SyncPassphrase.description: The passphrase typed again (checked against the folder by the route).

message.title: Message
message.description: What happened and what to do, for people

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: What the person can do about it, the main action first (none: wait, or the message says)

SyncProblem.title: SyncProblem
SyncProblem.description: Why sync is paused or needs the person (the web shows the words, never the code).

SyncProgress.title: SyncProgress
SyncProgress.description: How far a first save, or bringing a version over, has got.

hand_over.title: Hand Over
hand_over.description: Then stand by, so another computer can take over

added.title: Added
added.description: Letters added there since the two last agreed

newest.title: Newest
newest.description: Up to three letters, newest added first

items.title: Items
items.description: Dates and to-dos still open in that Ordnung

done.title: Done
done.description: Dates and to-dos marked done there

latest.title: Latest
latest.description: Its three latest changes (letters, dates, to-dos, notes, contracts), newest first: what tells two sides apart when their counts are alike

saved_at.title: Saved At
saved_at.description: That computer's clock: when it saved this version

arrived_at.title: Arrived At
arrived_at.description: This computer's clock: when it arrived here

complete.title: Complete
complete.description: It has fully arrived here (choosing one that hasn't waits for it)

arriving.description: What is still arriving of it

SyncSide.title: SyncSide
SyncSide.description: One computer's Ordnung in a choice.

on.title: On
on.description: The calendar date of the change (no clock time)

SyncSideChange.title: SyncSideChange
SyncSideChange.description: One of a side's latest changes: what it was made to, its title and the calendar date.

available.title: Available
available.description: Sync can be used on this computer (a password store; never the demo)

install_command.title: Install Command
install_command.description: The command that makes it available

connected.title: Connected
connected.description: This computer syncs through a folder

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: ``off`` (not connected), ``starting``, ``in_use`` (this computer is the one in use) or ``standing_by`` (another computer is: writes are refused)

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: ``idle``, ``saving``, ``waiting`` (for the sync tool), ``bringing_over`` (writes are refused for a moment) or ``keeping`` (writing a kept copy)

folder.title: Folder
folder.description: The sync folder on this computer

suggested_name.title: Suggested Name
suggested_name.description: The name offered when setting up (this computer's host name)

last_saved_at.title: Last Saved At
last_saved_at.description: This computer's clock: its last save into the folder

pending_changes.title: Pending Changes
pending_changes.description: This computer has changes that aren't in the sync folder yet

others_have_latest.title: Others Have Latest
others_have_latest.description: Another computer has received everything of this computer's (Disconnect and Delete everything ask twice when not)

up_to_date.title: Up To Date
up_to_date.description: Standing by: the newest version has fully arrived here

base_from.title: Base From
base_from.description: Whose version this computer's data is (“the copy this computer has”)

base_arrived_at.title: Base Arrived At
base_arrived_at.description: This computer's clock: when it arrived

take_over_waiting.title: Take Over Waiting
take_over_waiting.description: “Use Ordnung here” waits until everything has arrived

choice.description: Both computers changed: which to keep

kept_warning.title: Kept Warning
kept_warning.description: The kept copies take more than 2 GB in all

data_folder_synced.title: Data Folder Synced
data_folder_synced.description: Ordnung's data folder itself is inside a synced folder, so the sync tool uploads it unencrypted

SyncStatus.title: SyncStatus
SyncStatus.description: What Settings → Your computers, the top bar and the standing-by screen show.

older_copy.title: Older Copy
older_copy.description: Use the copy this computer has now instead of waiting for what arrives

cancel.title: Cancel
cancel.description: Stop a waiting take-over (or a waiting choice)

note.title: Note
note.description: what the answer check left out or quoted; shown apart from the text

note_label.title: Note Label
note_label.description: the note's label in the answer's language

checked.title: Checked
checked.description: the answer went through the claim-level check (answers stored before it did not)

ThreadMessage.title: ThreadMessage
ThreadMessage.description: A stored question or answer; an answer's check note is split off its text into ``note``.

TraceChange.title: TraceChange
TraceChange.description:
One thing two readings of a letter decided differently (a date, a quote's grounding, a
model call's outcome …); ``before``/``after`` are ``None`` when the step is missing in that reading.

TraceComparison.title: TraceComparison
TraceComparison.description: What a later reading (``head``) decided differently from an earlier one (``base``).

TraceExport.title: TraceExport
TraceExport.description: Every kept reading of the letters not in the trash, as stored (for "Download your records").

TraceRun.title: TraceRun
TraceRun.description: One reading of a letter, summed up (its root span and its model calls).

TraceSpan.title: TraceSpan
TraceSpan.description: A step of a reading as the "How it was read" view shows it (display order, depth-first).

TraceSpanRecord.title: TraceSpanRecord
TraceSpanRecord.description:
One stored step of one reading of a letter (``trace_spans``).

``key`` names the step within its reading (``run/verify:quotes/verify:item:<slot>``) and is the
same in every reading of the letter, so two readings can be compared step by step. ``attributes``
hold only what code computed or decided and the ids of the records a step used or produced —
never letter text (the written policy is :mod:`ordnung.trace.facts`).

TrackingInfo.title: TrackingInfo
TrackingInfo.description: A letter's tracking number as Ordnung read it (``drafts.proof.parse_tracking_number``).

TrackingUpdate.title: TrackingUpdate
TrackingUpdate.description: A sent letter's tracking number (``null`` or empty removes it).

TransferValues.title: TransferValues
TransferValues.description: The transfer details a GiroCode carries — what the person compares with the paper letter.

UploadError.title: UploadError
UploadError.description: A file that was not accepted, with the reason written for the person.

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.description: ids of letters that were already in Ordnung

UploadResult.title: UploadResult
UploadResult.description: ``POST /api/documents``: letters queued for reading, their jobs, duplicates and rejections.

UsageStats.title: UsageStats
UsageStats.description: Model use in total and per purpose; ``input_tokens`` counts every prompt token, cached ones too.

WaitingEntry.title: WaitingEntry
WaitingEntry.description:
Something the person is owed — a reply, money or a callback (``secretary.waiting``), worked out on
read. ``answered``: a letter linked to it arrived (``answered_by``); nothing is closed for the person,
closing the follow-up to-do (``followup_item_id``) or marking the money received is their click.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The item's, letter's or draft's kind, or “contract” (or “call”, a promise)

due_date.title: Due Date
due_date.description: The due date, when the row's date is an earlier day to act (send by, act today)

overdue.title: Overdue
overdue.description: Counted in the session's overdue (never on Compare with the letter)

item.description: The to-do itself (Pay and Confirm need it)

WeekEntry.title: WeekEntry
WeekEntry.description: One row of a weekly-session step: a letter, a to-do, a contract decision or a letter you wrote.

more.title: More
more.description: Rows left out to keep the step short

WeekStep.title: WeekStep
WeekStep.description: One step of the weekly session.

since.title: Since
since.description: New since this day (the last session, else a week ago)

due.title: Due
due.description: Today shows its one gentle prompt

next_prompt.title: Next Prompt
next_prompt.description: The day Today suggests the session next (none while it is due)

overdue.title: Overdue
overdue.description: Deadlines, payments and tasks past their due date: never “All clear”

next_deadline.description: The earliest day to act from today on: “All clear until …”

due_today.title: Due Today

BriefUpdatedEvent.description: ``brief.updated``: a new secretary's note was written.

DemoMailEvent.title: DemoMailEvent

DocumentDeletedEvent.description: ``document.deleted``: a letter went to the trash (or was deleted for good).
DocumentDeletedEvent.title: DocumentDeletedEvent

DocumentProcessedEvent.description: ``document.processed``: a letter was read (``status`` is its new status).
DocumentProcessedEvent.title: DocumentProcessedEvent

DraftSentEvent.description: ``draft.sent``: the person sent a letter; ``item_id`` is the follow-up to-do.
DraftSentEvent.title: DraftSentEvent

FolderUpdatedEvent.description: ``folder.updated``: the watched folder started, stopped, hit a problem or brought in a file.
FolderUpdatedEvent.title: FolderUpdatedEvent

ItemUpdatedEvent.description: ``item.updated``: to-dos changed (``item_id`` when it was one).

JobProgressEvent.description: ``job.progress``: a reading job moved to another stage (or finished, failed or is waiting).
JobProgressEvent.title: JobProgressEvent

installed or not signed in (``until`` empty: continues once Claude is ready).

ReviewFailedEvent.description: ``review.failed``: the on-demand review could not run.
ReviewFailedEvent.title: ReviewFailedEvent

ServerEvents.description:
Every live event of ``GET /api/events``: the SSE event name → the model of its JSON data.

Publishing an event that is not listed here (or with other fields) is a bug; a test checks it.

SuggestionsUpdatedEvent.description: ``suggestions.updated``: Ideas changed (triggers, a review, an answer, the daily tick).
SuggestionsUpdatedEvent.title: SuggestionsUpdatedEvent

SyncUpdatedEvent.description:
``sync.updated``: hand-off sync's status changed (``GET /api/sync``); ``replaced``: this computer's
data was just replaced (a take-over, a choice, a change brought in), so every page loads again.
SyncUpdatedEvent.title: SyncUpdatedEvent
